title: Enigma y’entebe ey’ewala
intro: Kabaka ow’amaanyi, eyaweebwa omukisa obufuzi obw’ekitalo, yayolekagana n’okusoomoozebwa okw’enjawulo okwali kuzingiramu nnaabagereka okuva mu nsi ey’ewala. Kabaka yafuba okulaga amaanyi n’amagezi ag’obwakatonda, n’atandikawo ekintu ekitali kya bulijjo ekyamenya amateeka g’ebiseera n’ekifo. Osobola okuggya ebikwata ku kintu kino eky’ekyamagero?
clues: Omufuzi yaweebwa obuyinza bungi nnyo, nga mw’otwalidde n’okufuga ebitonde ebitalabika n’obusobozi okuduumira empewo.
Omufuzi ono yafuna amawulire ga nnaabagereka omugagga eyali asinza enjuba, era n’asalawo okumuyita mu lubiri.
Nga nnaabagereka tannatuuka, omufuzi yalaga nti yali ayagala okuleeta entebe ye ey’obuyinza ey’ekitalo okuva mu bwakabaka bwe obw’ewala.
Omujinni ow’amaanyi yawaayo okuggya ekintu ekyo nga omufuzi tannasituka okuva mu lukiiko lwe.
Kyokka, omuntu eyali amanyi ennyo Ebyawandiikibwa eby’Obwakatonda yawaayo okuggyawo mu bwangu n’okusingawo, n’amaliriza omulimu ogwo mu kaseera katono.
Bwe yatuuka, omufuzi yalagira ekintu ekyo kikyusibwe okugezesa amagezi ga nnaabagereka n’okutegeera kwe ng’asembayo okutuuka mu lubiri.
verse: It was said to her, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace paved with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allah, Lord of the worlds." (An-Naml 27:44)
arabic: قِيلَ لَهَا ادْخُلِي الصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةً وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُ صَرْحٌ مُّمَرَّدٌ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَانَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
